# ShadowHook source pin

- Upstream: https://github.com/bytedance/android-inline-hook
- Release: `v2.0.1`
- Commit: `854c775c2c3676e57a0f383597ebf420b5204161`
- Upstream license: MIT (`LICENSE`)
- Native source: upstream `shadowhook/src/main/cpp`, copied without source edits.
- Bundled subcomponents retain their upstream license files and notices.

ShadowHook replaces inline instruction patching and the process-wide SIGTRAP handler previously used by the experimental trace. Engine hooks remain opt-in and separately gated.
